obligations.expected_behavior: Enforce a finite execution-time bound for every external process.
forbidden_result: An external process runs beyond its configured time bound.
An external process can hang without timeout termination.
obligations.observable_result: For each external-process run, elapsed execution time is at or below the enforced bound or the process is terminated at the bound.
obligations.state_after: The external process has completed or been terminated within its time budget.
obligations.state_before: An external process is eligible to execute without a guaranteed finite time limit.
obligations.subject: External process execution time
obligations.trigger: Whenever an external process is executed.

obligations.expected_behavior: Enforce a finite output bound for every external process.
forbidden_result: An external process emits output beyond its configured output bound.
obligations.observable_result: For each external-process run, produced output is at or below the enforced bound or further output is deterministically stopped or rejected at the bound.
obligations.state_after: The external process output remains within its output budget.
obligations.state_before: An external process is eligible to emit output without a guaranteed finite limit.
obligations.subject: External process output
obligations.trigger: Whenever an external process produces output.

obligations.expected_behavior: Enforce a finite execution-time bound for every aggregate.
forbidden_result: An aggregate runs beyond its configured time bound.
An aggregate can remain indefinitely non-terminal.
obligations.observable_result: For each aggregate run, elapsed aggregate time is at or below the enforced bound or the aggregate is terminated at the bound.
obligations.state_after: The aggregate has completed or been terminated within its time budget.
obligations.state_before: An aggregate is eligible to execute without a guaranteed finite time limit.
obligations.subject: Aggregate execution time

obligations.expected_behavior: Enforce a finite output bound for every aggregate.
forbidden_result: An aggregate emits output beyond its configured output bound.
Unbounded aggregate output accumulation is allowed.
obligations.observable_result: For each aggregate run, produced output is at or below the enforced bound or further output is deterministically stopped or rejected at the bound.
obligations.state_after: The aggregate output remains within its output budget.
obligations.state_before: An aggregate is eligible to emit output without a guaranteed finite limit.
obligations.subject: Aggregate output

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminate every external process in a deterministic terminal state.
forbidden_result: An external process ends in an indeterminate or non-reproducible state.
The process remains without a terminal state after execution is stopped.
obligations.observable_result: The external-process execution record contains one deterministic terminal state for the same governing inputs and budget conditions.
obligations.state_after: The external process has exactly one recorded deterministic terminal state.
obligations.state_before: An external process may complete or be stopped without a deterministic terminal-state guarantee.
obligations.subject: External process terminal state
obligations.trigger: When an external process completes, times out, exceeds output budget, or is otherwise stopped.

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminate every aggregate in a deterministic terminal state.
forbidden_result: An aggregate ends in an indeterminate or non-reproducible state.
The aggregate remains without a terminal state after execution is stopped.
obligations.observable_result: The aggregate execution record contains one deterministic terminal state for the same governing inputs and budget conditions.
obligations.state_after: The aggregate has exactly one recorded deterministic terminal state.
obligations.state_before: An aggregate may complete or be stopped without a deterministic terminal-state guarantee.
obligations.subject: Aggregate terminal state
obligations.trigger: When an aggregate completes, times out, exceeds output budget, or is otherwise stopped.

obligations.expected_behavior: Classify any execution that exhausts its time or output budget as unsuccessful.
forbidden_result: A budget-exhausted execution is reported as successful.
Budget exhaustion is treated as a successful terminal outcome.
obligations.observable_result: The terminal execution result explicitly records unsuccessful status when any applicable budget is exhausted.
obligations.state_after: The budget-exhausted execution is marked unsuccessful.
obligations.state_before: An execution is running under finite budgets and has not yet exhausted one.
obligations.subject: Budget exhaustion outcome
obligations.trigger: When an external-process or aggregate time/output budget is exhausted.

obligations.expected_behavior: Keep coverage unchanged by budget exhaustion; an unsuccessful exhausted run must not reduce the coverage scope or calculation.
forbidden_result: Coverage is reduced because a run exhausted its budget.
Coverage omits obligations solely because budget exhaustion made the run unsuccessful.
An unsuccessful budget-exhausted result is counted as a reason to lower coverage.
obligations.observable_result: Coverage before and after recording budget exhaustion is computed over the same obligation set, with no reduction attributable to exhaustion.
obligations.state_after: The run is unsuccessful while coverage remains at the pre-exhaustion scope and calculation.
obligations.state_before: Coverage is being evaluated while an execution may exhaust a budget.
obligations.subject: Coverage under budget exhaustion
obligations.trigger: When budget exhaustion is recorded during an execution evaluated for coverage.
